entities.name: Amalric I of Jerusalem
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Amalric, formerly known in historiography as Amalric I, was the king of Jerusalem from 1163 until his death. His Muslim adversaries described him as the bravest and cleverest of the crusader kings.
